slug: 2024-12-01 Niger Civil Status (État Civil) Analysis Report 2023 (INS Niger)

facts.fact: The INS foreword states that 101 communes are 'in production' on the computerised civil-status system, against 266 communes and communal arrondissements to be covered (101 of 266, a share of communes); the document gives no date beyond 'at present', so its cover date of December 2024 is used.

The INS foreword states that more than 130 communes have been given equipment allowing them to digitise civil-status acts, against 266 communes and communal arrondissements (130 of 266, a floor); undated beyond 'at present', so the cover date of December 2024 is used.
INS states that the five communal arrondissements of Niamey were digitised in 2023 and that their principal centres feed the INCI database, the only data the report analyses.

INS states that events are declared at the centres and passed to the commune, where agents key the acts on machines connected to a server housed at the DGECM-R, the civil-status officer validates each act and it is then saved automatically to that server; the report elsewhere calls the system semi-computerised.
The DGECM-R database for the five Niamey arrondissements holds 72,459 births and 6,524 deaths registered in 2023 (and 5,565 marriages), according to INS.

INS states that the server receiving the keyed acts is housed at the Direction Générale de l'Etat Civil, des Migrations et des Réfugiés (DGECM-R), which supplies the databases to INS for the annual statistics.
INS states that the computerisation of civil-status acts in Niger began in 2023, and that this report on 2023 is the first edition since the computerised system was put in place.

systems.country_label: application INCI; système informatisé de l'état civil
systems.platform: INCI application, with a central server
systems.owner: Direction Générale de l'Etat Civil, des Migrations et des Réfugiés (DGECM-R), Ministry of the Interior
systems.tiers: principal centres of communes and communal arrondissements; the five Niamey arrondissements in 2023; 101 communes in production of more than 130 equipped, out of 266

note: Read from the artefact PDF. Cover dated December 2024, page footers 'N°01 Mars 2025'; the report covers Niamey only. The office the system runs in is the commune's principal centre: declarations taken at declaration centres reach it on paper before the act is keyed.
